title: Fixed-pair scalar square of a projection-normalized Tate tower
statement: For a Noetherian scheme T, prime ell invertible on T, an AdicTower M with finite-level identifications e and strict tower equality h, fixed indices a<=b, selected projection-normalized ordinary models cb and ca at b and a, and a generator-normalized CoefficientLineComparison r, assume the two selected models satisfy the ordinary balancing and evaluation normalization clauses of ProjectionNormalized. Then extension of e_b followed by scalarComparison and derivedRealization of proTwistMap d r equals M.normalization followed by e_a.

source.place: Step 4: equality of normalization squares for a fixed comparable pair of lem-pur-normalized-tate-tensor-reductions

proof.text: Evaluate both maps on the selected ordinary root-tensor models. ProjectionBalanced gives the scalar and root generator formula, while the two evaluation normalization clauses transport it through exact single/evaluation comparisons. The scalar adjunction mate and strict tower transition identify the result with M.normalization; generator equality extends by sheafification, including zero tensors, equal indices and empty schemes.

proof_origin.place: Step 4: equality of normalization squares for a fixed comparable pair

mathlib_searches.results: BDeRhamPlus, BDeRham, Ideal.rootsOfUnityMapQuot, AdicCompletion.ofTensorProductEquivOfFiniteNoetherian_symm_of; no sheaf or derived normalization theorem. Loogle CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp supplies only assembly glue.

Mathlib has no matching project predicates. The project has the parent NormalizedTateTensorTowerCore, its assembled parent and the separate constructibility and zero clauses. QuotientRootLineComparison already proves existence of normalized finite comparisons and is reused. OrdinaryLineDerivedScalarComparison is general line/scalar theory but does not identify these actual integral projections or construct this strict ordinary quotient tower.

lean.statement:
theorem tateTensor_normalizedSquare_of_pair
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime]
    (hT : IsUnit (ell : Γ(T, ⊤))) (d : ℕ)
    (M : AdicTower T (datum.{u} ell))
    (e : ∀ n : ℕ, M.level n ≅ (derivedRealization T ell n).obj (finiteTwist T ell n d))
    (h : M.tower = strictDerivedTower T ell d)
    (b a : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (cb : (realization T ell b).obj (finiteSheaf T ell b d) ≅ quotientLine T ell b d)
    (ca : (realization T ell a).obj (finiteSheaf T ell a d) ≅ quotientLine T ell a d)
    (hb : normalizedAt T ell hT d M e h b cb)
    (ha : normalizedAt T ell hT d M e h a ca)
    (r : CoefficientLineComparison
      (FiniteReduction.quotient.{u} ell (Nat.add_le_add_right hab 1))
      (ell ^ (b + 1)) (ell ^ (a + 1))
      (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) T) :
    (pbcDerivedExtend (pbcAdicQuotient T (datum.{u} ell) b a hab)).map (e b).hom ≫
        (scalarComparison T ell b a hab).hom.app (finiteTwist T ell b d) ≫
        (derivedRealization T ell a).map (proTwistMap d r) =
      (M.normalization b a hab).hom ≫ (e a).hom
